overview.zh: 此图解释手动关节通道两类动作：Run 只发送指定关节目标；use 复选框维护关节/电机 scope。关键区别是 UI 选择变化不会自动等于电机收到命令。
overview.en: This graph covers two Joint Channels actions: Run sends a target for one joint, while use checkboxes maintain joint/motor scope. A UI selection change does not itself mean a motor received a command.

zh.plain: Joint Channels 控制按所选关节下发目标，或修改关节参与范围。关节勾选会同步对应电机和分组复选框。
zh.condition: 由 Joint Channels 页面中的 Run 行按钮或 use 勾选框触发；本图代码只说明桌面端处理。
zh.effect: Run 调用 send_joint_row；勾选调用 _on_joint_use_changed，进而更新所选掩码、分组状态、当前模式 scope 和操作按钮。
zh.failure: 控制器未就绪或启动守卫拒绝时，Run 提前返回；勾选变化遇到内部同步保护时不重新处理。
zh.recovery: 先查看 ENABLE 与串口状态，再检查目标输入及所选 joint scope。
zh.unknown: 未展示 P4 对每条关节命令的最终执行反馈和物理关节是否到位。
zh.difference: 该页发送关节目标，区别于 Motor Channels 的电机绝对位置命令。
zh.change: 基线没有把该页面标记为本次新增变更。

en.plain: Joint Channels sends joint targets for the selected scope and edits which joints participate. Toggling a joint also synchronizes its related motors and group checkboxes.
en.condition: Entered by a Run-row button or a use checkbox on the Joint Channels page; this is the desktop path.
en.effect: Run calls send_joint_row. A checkbox calls _on_joint_use_changed, which updates masks, group checks, the active mode scope, and action-button state.
en.failure: Run returns early if controller interaction is unavailable or its command-start guard rejects; checkbox callbacks ignore internally generated synchronization signals.
en.recovery: Check ENABLE and serial state, then verify the target input and selected joint scope.
en.unknown: The excerpts do not show P4 execution feedback for each command or whether a physical joint reaches its target.
en.difference: This page sends joint targets, unlike Motor Channels, which sends motor absolute-position commands.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this page as newly changed.

zh.plain: send_joint_row(idx) 把第 idx 行的手动目标转换为一次关节命令。源码先确认可交互，再记下用户设置目标并检查命令是否可启动。
zh.condition: 函数入口是对应 joint 行的 Run 操作；发送前要求 _controller_interaction_ready() 成立，且 _guard_joint_command_started() 允许继续。 原始条件：`not self._controller_interaction_ready(); not self._guard_joint_command_started()`。
zh.effect: 它构造 _single_joint_command_targets(idx)，调用 send_joint_targets(... live=False, command_joint_mask=(1 << idx))；成功路径将该行标记为运行并更新状态栏。
zh.failure: 任一 readiness 检查未通过都会提前 return，所以不会执行后续发送及行状态更新。
zh.recovery: 先通过 ENABLE 使控制器就绪；若被拒绝，查看状态栏，再确认 joint index 与目标值。
zh.unknown: 片段没有显示 send_joint_targets 返回结果如何映射到电机反馈或目标完成。
zh.difference: command_joint_mask 限定这条命令针对所选 joint 行；live=False 表示这是单次手动下发。
zh.change: 基线没有将该 handler 标记为本次变更。

en.plain: send_joint_row(idx) turns row idx into a one-shot joint command. It first checks interaction readiness, records that the user set the target, and then checks whether command startup is allowed.
en.condition: Entered by the Run action for a joint row. _controller_interaction_ready() must pass and _guard_joint_command_started() must permit dispatch. 原始条件：`not self._controller_interaction_ready(); not self._guard_joint_command_started()`。
en.effect: It builds _single_joint_command_targets(idx), calls send_joint_targets(... live=False, command_joint_mask=(1 << idx)), then marks that row running and updates the status text.
en.failure: Either readiness check can return early, skipping both the send and the row-state update.
en.recovery: Make the controller ready with ENABLE; if the request is rejected, read the status text and verify the joint index and target.
en.unknown: The excerpt does not show how send_joint_targets results become motor feedback or target-completion status.
en.difference: command_joint_mask limits this request to the selected joint row; live=False marks a one-shot manual send.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this handler as changed.

zh.plain: 这个守卫确认控制器当前是否允许 UI 与控制后端交互。条件为真代表 not ready，因此 joint 行命令不再继续。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`not self._controller_interaction_ready()`。取反后的判断为真即交互尚未就绪。
zh.effect: 真分支直接 return；假分支继续标记用户目标并检查启动守卫。
zh.failure: 条件为真时控制器交互未就绪，因此提前拒绝；为假时继续到命令启动守卫。
zh.recovery: 查看控制器状态、串口连接和启动流程是否完成，然后重新点击 Run。
zh.unknown: 该 helper 的内部就绪条件未包含在此图源码中，具体被哪些状态阻止需查其定义。
zh.difference: 这是整条命令的入口门槛，不是关节目标范围校验。
zh.change: 基线没有标记此守卫为变更。

en.plain: This guard checks whether UI interaction with the controller is currently allowed. A true result means the controller is not ready, so the joint-row command stops.
en.condition: Raw condition: `not self._controller_interaction_ready()`. True means interaction is not ready.
en.effect: The true branch returns immediately; false continues to record the user target and check command startup.
en.failure: When true controller interaction is not ready, so the request is rejected early; when false it proceeds to the command-start guard.
en.recovery: Inspect controller state, serial connection, and startup completion, then retry Run.
en.unknown: The helper implementation is outside this graph packet, so the exact states that block interaction are not established here.
en.difference: This is the command-entry gate, not a joint-target range check.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: 第二道守卫询问同一 joint 控制请求是否已进入启动阶段。它用来避免重复启动或与正在开始的命令冲突。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`not self._guard_joint_command_started()`。为真表示启动守卫没有放行。
zh.effect: 真时函数提前返回；假时计算该关节目标并发送带单关节掩码的请求。
zh.failure: 条件为真时命令启动未获准，函数提前返回；为假时继续构造并发送该关节目标。
zh.recovery: 等待现有启动/命令状态稳定，再检查所选 joint 和控制器状态后重试。
zh.unknown: 守卫具体检查哪些运行标志需看 _guard_joint_command_started 的定义；此源码片段未展开。
zh.difference: 它管命令启动时序，第一道守卫管总体交互就绪，两者阻断原因不同。
zh.change: 基线没有标记此守卫为变更。

en.plain: The second guard checks whether this joint command has already entered a startup path. It prevents a duplicate start or conflict with a command that is still starting.
en.condition: Raw condition: `not self._guard_joint_command_started()`. True means the startup guard did not allow dispatch.
en.effect: On true the function returns; on false it computes this joint target and sends a request masked to one joint.
en.failure: When true command startup is not allowed and the function returns; when false it builds and sends this joint target.
en.recovery: Wait for the current startup/command state to settle, verify the selected joint and controller state, then retry.
en.unknown: The flags checked internally are not shown; inspect _guard_joint_command_started for its exact policy.
en.difference: This guard controls command-start timing; the first guard controls general interaction readiness.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: _on_joint_use_changed(joint_idx, checked) 维护 joint 参与集合，并让 UI 其他表示与之保持一致。这里的 checked 是复选框的新值。
zh.condition: 用户切换 joint use 复选框时调用；内部由 _scope_update_guard 阻止同步产生的信号递归进入。 原始条件：`bool(getattr(self, "_scope_update_guard", False)); 0 <= int(joint_idx) < ENCODER_COUNT; checked`。
zh.effect: 有效索引对应的 bit 在 _selected_joint_mask 中置位或清零；之后同步 motor 选择、分组勾选、当前模式 scope 和手动操作按钮。
zh.failure: 若正在程序化同步，函数直接返回；无效 joint_idx 不改 joint mask，但其后的同步函数仍会被调用。
zh.recovery: 如果页面选择与执行 scope 不一致，重新勾选目标 joint 并观察分组和对应 motor 项是否同步。
zh.unknown: 后端如何依据 scope 过滤实际控制量由其他控制路径决定，本函数只维护 UI 选择与应用动作。
zh.difference: 勾选变化是范围编辑；它不直接发送 send_joint_targets。
zh.change: 基线没有标记该回调为变更。

en.plain: _on_joint_use_changed(joint_idx, checked) maintains the participating-joint set and synchronizes other UI representations. checked is the checkbox’s new value.
en.condition: Called when a joint-use checkbox changes. _scope_update_guard prevents programmatic synchronization from recursively re-entering the callback. 原始条件：`bool(getattr(self, "_scope_update_guard", False)); 0 <= int(joint_idx) < ENCODER_COUNT; checked`。
en.effect: For a valid index, its bit is set or cleared in _selected_joint_mask; then motor selection, group checks, active-mode scope, and manual action buttons are refreshed.
en.failure: If a synchronization is already in progress, the callback returns. An invalid joint_idx does not change the joint mask, though later sync helpers are still called.
en.recovery: If the visible selection and active scope disagree, select the intended joints again and check their group and motor rows.
en.unknown: Other control paths decide how the backend applies scope; this callback maintains UI selection and applies it.
en.difference: A checkbox change edits scope; it does not directly call send_joint_targets.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this callback as changed.

zh.plain: 这是防止复选框同步递归的保护位。同步 motor checkbox 时会暂时把 _scope_update_guard 设为 True，避免程序写回勾选状态又触发业务回调。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`bool(getattr(self, "_scope_update_guard", False))`。getattr 提供默认 False，bool 统一为布尔值。
zh.effect: 为真时 _on_joint_use_changed 立即返回；为假时才处理用户真实的勾选变化。
zh.failure: 条件为真时这是内部回写信号，回调立即返回；为假时当作用户操作继续处理。
zh.recovery: 无需手工复位；同步代码在 finally 中将 guard 恢复为 False。
zh.unknown: 如果异常导致同步范围不完整，finally 的具体执行以完整实现为准；当前片段显示 guard 的配对位置。
zh.difference: 这是重入抑制，不是设备状态或安全联锁。
zh.change: 基线没有标记该保护位为变更。

en.plain: This flag prevents recursive checkbox synchronization. While motor checkboxes are updated programmatically, _scope_update_guard becomes True so those UI writes do not re-enter the business callback.
en.condition: Raw condition: `bool(getattr(self, "_scope_update_guard", False))`. getattr defaults to False and bool normalizes the value.
en.effect: When true, _on_joint_use_changed returns immediately; when false, it processes a user selection change.
en.failure: When true this is an internal UI write and the callback returns; when false it processes a user action.
en.recovery: No manual reset is required; the synchronization code clears the guard in a finally block.
en.unknown: If synchronization raises an exception, the paired finally behavior depends on the complete implementation; the packet shows the guard’s set/reset sites.
en.difference: This is re-entry suppression, not a device-state check or safety interlock.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this flag as changed.

zh.plain: 该判断检查 joint_idx 是否落在编码器/joint 通道数量范围内，只有有效下标才允许计算位掩码。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`0 <= int(joint_idx) < ENCODER_COUNT`。int 转换后要求索引从 0 开始且小于通道总数。
zh.effect: 真时计算 `1 << int(joint_idx)`，再按 checked 设置或清除 _selected_joint_mask 对应位。假时跳过掩码更新。
zh.failure: 条件为真时 joint 下标有效并更新对应 bit；为假时跳过 bitmask 写入，避免越界。
zh.recovery: 检查按钮绑定的行号是否从零起、是否超出 ENCODER_COUNT。
zh.unknown: ENCODER_COUNT 的数值定义不在此函数片段中。
zh.difference: 此检查保护数组/位掩码索引，和 _scope_update_guard 的递归保护不同。
zh.change: 基线没有标记该范围检查为变更。

en.plain: This check ensures joint_idx falls within the encoder/joint channel count before a bit is calculated.
en.condition: Raw condition: `0 <= int(joint_idx) < ENCODER_COUNT`. After integer conversion, the index must be zero-based and below the channel count.
en.effect: When true, the code calculates `1 << int(joint_idx)` and sets or clears that bit in _selected_joint_mask according to checked. When false, it skips the mask update.
en.failure: When true the joint index is valid and its bit is updated; when false the bitmask write is skipped to avoid an out-of-range index.
en.recovery: Check that the row binding uses zero-based indices and does not exceed ENCODER_COUNT.
en.unknown: The numeric definition of ENCODER_COUNT is outside this function excerpt.
en.difference: This protects array/bitmask indexing, unlike _scope_update_guard, which prevents recursive callbacks.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this bounds check as changed.

zh.plain: checked 表示用户希望把该 joint 纳入（True）或移出（False）控制范围；这个分支决定对应 bit 是置位还是清零。
zh.condition: 原始条件：`checked`。这是 Qt 复选框发出的新选中状态。
zh.effect: checked 为真时将 bit OR 进 _selected_joint_mask；为假时用按位取反清除该 bit。
zh.failure: 条件为真时把该 joint 加入所选范围；为假时清除对应位并将它移出范围。
zh.recovery: 如果勾选后没有进入 active scope，检查模式是否支持该范围并看状态栏反馈。
zh.unknown: 范围接受与否由 _apply_active_scope_for_current_mode 及下游控制器决定，此处不保证它被接受。
zh.difference: 它修改桌面端 joint mask；不是电机已经接收命令的证明。
zh.change: 基线没有标记该分支为变更。

en.plain: checked indicates whether the user wants this joint included (True) or removed (False) from the control scope; it selects whether the bit is set or cleared.
en.condition: Raw condition: `checked`. This is the new selected state emitted by the Qt checkbox.
en.effect: True ORs the bit into _selected_joint_mask; false clears it with a bitwise mask.
en.failure: When true the joint is included in the selected scope; when false its bit is cleared and it is removed.
en.recovery: If the selection does not become active, check whether the current mode supports it and read the status feedback.
en.unknown: Acceptance is decided by _apply_active_scope_for_current_mode and the lower controller; this callback does not guarantee acceptance.
en.difference: It edits the desktop joint mask; it is not proof that a motor received a command.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this branch as changed.

zh.failure: 条件为真时控制器交互未就绪，因此提前拒绝；为假时继续到命令启动守卫。
zh.recovery: 查看控制器状态、串口连接和启动流程是否完成，然后重新点击 Run。
zh.unknown: 该 helper 的内部就绪条件未包含在此图源码中，具体被哪些状态阻止需查其定义。
zh.difference: 条件只决定桌面端继续或返回，不是 P4 已执行命令的确认。
zh.change: 基线没有标记此守卫为变更。

en.effect: True ORs the bit into _selected_joint_mask; false clears it with a bitwise mask.
en.failure: When true the joint is included in the selected scope; when false its bit is cleared and it is removed.
en.recovery: If the selection does not become active, check whether the current mode supports it and read the status feedback.
en.unknown: Acceptance is decided by _apply_active_scope_for_current_mode and the lower controller; this callback does not guarantee acceptance.
en.difference: The condition only decides whether the desktop handler continues or returns; it does not confirm P4 execution.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this branch as changed.
